drafts.angle: AI will rewrite ads too (rides @rauchg rewrite thesis)
drafts.draft_en:
We will all learn this about AI-made ads too:

• Most of them ship off-brand
• Most of them break a claim rule
• Most of them would never clear legal

AI will rewrite creative volume. Brands still need a gate that returns approve, fix, or block before publish.

Run your next AI ad through Aubric before it hits the platform.
drafts.video_tip: 15s vertical: three AI ads flash on screen stamped OFF-BRAND / CLAIM FAIL / POLICY RISK, then one clean cut to APPROVE. End on Aubric URL. Match @rauchg's bullet rhythm with short on-screen labels.

drafts.angle: 24h audit scoreboard for ads (rides @rauchg Security Review numbers)
drafts.draft_en:
In just 24 hours of AI ad generation, your team can invent more claims than legal can read.

Vercel just showed what a free security review agent does to code: thousands of issues found, hundreds patched automatically.

Creative needs the same loop. Aubric checks each claim, image, frame, and voiceover against brand rules, legal approvals, and ad-platform policy, then returns approve, fix, or block.

Turn it on for every draft before spend.
drafts.video_tip: 20s screen capture: paste an AI-generated ad, watch a live counter of issues found and fixes suggested, freeze on APPROVE / FIX / BLOCK. Use concrete on-screen numbers from a real (sanitized) run; do not invent metrics.

drafts.angle: How to not ship AI slop (rides @gregisenberg 'How to not write AI slop')
drafts.draft_en:
How to not ship AI slop in ads:

1. Write the brand rules as executable checks, not a PDF nobody opens
2. Ban the vague words your model loves ("best", "guaranteed", "#1") unless legal cleared them
3. Run every frame and voiceover through the same gate as the copy
4. Require approve, fix, or block before anyone hits publish

Aubric is that gate for creative. Steal the checklist, then put a real verifier behind it.
drafts.video_tip: 25s vertical list video: each rule appears as a sticky note, then gets stamped CHECKED. Final frame: Aubric verdict screen. This format wins on bookmarks, so keep it scannable and under 5 lines.
